verdict.rationale: OpenHands documents explicit automations that open pull requests automatically on task completion (e.g., failed workflow fixes and security remediations both result in opening a PR), plus general git/GitHub integration and workflow automation triggers via webhooks/schedules. Missing for 10: a dedicated first-party doc specifically titled 'auto-open PR on task completion' as a generic configurable option (rather than only via specific automation templates), and independent/hands-on confirmation.
